description: Adload is an adware/PUA bundler that monetizes systems by injecting advertisements and hijacking browser settings. IoCs include modified shortcut targets, rogue browser extensions, and frequent calls to advertising and tracking domains. Persistence relies on Scheduled Tasks and Run keys that relaunch helper components after reboot. Overall, the pattern aligns with Windows PUA/adware campaigns.
